question: Unemployment is measured in India on the methods prescribed by the:
solution:
The correct answer is **__National Sample Survey Organisation.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unemployment **is **measured in India** on the methods prescribed **by **the **National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO)**.

 
 
• According to the **International Labour Organization (ILO)**, **unemployment **is defined as** not having a job but is available for work and actively looking for one.**
 
• The **unemployment rate** is measured as the **ratio of the unemployed to the labour force.**
 
• The total number of employed and unemployed people is known as the** labor force.**
 
 
• People who are neither employed nor jobless, such as students and people who perform unpaid household labor, are seen as not being in the labor force.
 
 
 
 
 
• The **NSSO **is the nodal agency responsible for **conducting surveys and collecting data on various socio-economic aspects** of the country, including employment and unemployment.
 
 
• It was **set up in 1950** to conduct periodic surveys on employment and unemployment, which are used to estimate the unemployment rate in the country.
 
• In **2019**, the Central Statistical Office (**CSO**) and the National Sample Survey Office (**NSSO**) **combined **to **become **the **National Statistical Office (NSO)** under **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MOSPI).**
 
 
 
• Apart from NSSO, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) also publishes data on employment and unemployment, but it is primarily focused on the banking and financial sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Employment Department** under **Ministry of Labour & Employment** is responsible for formulating policies and schemes for employment generation and skill development in the country.
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** is India’s central bank.
 
 
• In compliance with the terms of the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934,** it was **founded **on **April 1, 1935** in **Calcutta**.
 
 
• It was permanently** moved to Mumbai in 1937.**
 
 
 
• Though originally privately owned, since **nationalisation in 1949**, the Reserve Bank is fully owned by the Government of India.
 
• It regulates the** issue of Bank notes** and **keeping of reserves** with a view to securing** monetary stability in India **and generally to operate the currency and credit system of the country to its advantage.
 
• It also monitors the monetary policies through its **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC).**
 
 
 
• The **National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)** was **founded **in **1992 **with the main goal of** increasing market transparency in India's equity markets.**
 
 
• It was **recognised **as a stock exchange** by SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India) in1993** and started its **operations in 1994.**
 
• Its **headquarters is in Mumbai.** It is a market facilitator for trades in wholesale debt, stocks, and derivatives.
 
• In **1994**, it **became the first exchange in India to provide modern, completely automated electronic trading.**
